faq-find-pharmacy-near-me.subject: How do I find a pharmacy near me?
faq-find-pharmacy-near-me.content: Use the Pharmacies page to search by name, address, region, pharmacy type, delivery support, insurance support, and opening status when available.

faq-search-name-address.subject: Can I search by pharmacy name or address?
faq-search-name-address.content: Yes. Type a pharmacy name, street, district, or landmark into the search field and QuickMeds will match available pharmacy profiles.

faq-account-needed-browse.subject: Do I need an account to browse pharmacies?
faq-account-needed-browse.content: No. You can browse public pharmacy listings without signing in. Some actions, such as messaging, following, liking, and commenting, require an account.

faq-open-now.subject: What does "Open now" mean?
faq-open-now.content: Open status is calculated from the pharmacy's saved working hours and timezone. If hours are missing, QuickMeds does not assume the pharmacy is open.

faq-delivery.subject: How do I know if a pharmacy offers delivery?
faq-delivery.content: Pharmacy cards and detail pages show whether delivery is available and, when provided, the delivery fee in UZS.

faq-insurance.subject: How do I know if a pharmacy accepts insurance?
faq-insurance.content: Look for the insurance information on the pharmacy card or pharmacy detail page. Confirm directly with the pharmacy before visiting.

faq-stock-prices.subject: Can QuickMeds confirm medicine stock or prices?
faq-stock-prices.content: Not yet. QuickMeds helps you discover and contact pharmacies. Please message or call the pharmacy to confirm current medicine availability and prices.

faq-contact-pharmacy.subject: How do I contact a pharmacy?
faq-contact-pharmacy.content: Open the pharmacy detail page and use the message form or available contact details.

faq-message-location.subject: Where do my pharmacy messages appear?
faq-message-location.content: Signed-in users can see pharmacy conversations in My Page under Messages.

faq-message-images.subject: Can I send images in a pharmacy message?
faq-message-images.content: Yes, where messaging is available, you can attach supported image files along with your message.

faq-own-pharmacy-message.subject: Why can't I message my own pharmacy?
faq-own-pharmacy-message.content: Pharmacy Owners cannot start customer conversations with their own pharmacy listing.

faq-save-like-pharmacy.subject: How do I save or like a pharmacy?
faq-save-like-pharmacy.content: Sign in, then use the heart action on pharmacy cards or detail pages. Saved pharmacies appear in your account areas where supported.

faq-follow-member-owner.subject: How do I follow a member or Pharmacy Owner?
faq-follow-member-owner.content: Open their public profile and use Follow. You can manage followers and followings from My Page.

faq-comments.subject: Can I leave comments on a pharmacy?
faq-comments.content: Yes, signed-in users can comment on pharmacy detail pages where comments are enabled. Keep comments relevant and respectful.

faq-wrong-info.subject: What should I do if information looks wrong?
faq-wrong-info.content: Contact the pharmacy directly for urgent questions. For platform or listing issues, use QuickMeds support/admin contact channels when available.

faq-become-owner.subject: How do I become a Pharmacy Owner?
faq-become-owner.content: Sign in and use the Pharmacy Owner option in My Page. Once approved or enabled, you can add and manage pharmacy listings.

faq-add-listing.subject: How do I add a pharmacy listing?
faq-add-listing.content: Pharmacy Owners can go to My Page, choose Add Pharmacy, complete the required pharmacy details, upload images, and save the listing.

faq-edit-listing.subject: Can I edit my pharmacy after publishing it?
faq-edit-listing.content: Yes. Pharmacy Owners can manage existing listings from My Page under My Pharmacies.
